DOCKET NO. 
25-00005
ORDER APPROVING INTERCONNECTION AGREEMENT 
This Interconnection Agreement (the “Agreement”), negotiated between AT&T Tennessee 
(“AT&T TN”) and Brightspeed Broadband, LLC (“CLEC”) pursuant to 47 U.S.C. §251 and §252, 
was filed with the Tennessee Public Utility Commission (the “Commission”) on January 17, 2025.1 
The Agreement has been reviewed, and no portion discriminates against a telecommunications carrier 
that is not a party to the agreement. 
A Notice was filed by the Commission on February 24, 2025, informing the public that the 
Agreement would be deemed approved by the Commission within ten (10) days of the filing of the 
Notice unless an objection to the Agreement was filed with the Commission. No objection to the 
Agreement was received by the Commission. 
Pursuant to the Notice and absent any objection having been filed with the Commission, the 
Agreement is approved effective as of March 6, 2025. 
ATTEST: 
_____________________________________ 
Earl R. Taylor, Executive Director
